tagline: Offline Torah Notes & Hebrew Handwriting OCR Studio
taglineHebrew: סטודיו אופליין לזיהוי ועריכת כתב יד תורני ומחברות שיעורים
releaseTitle: v1.4.2 — Re-scan All Pages Batch Mode, Upgraded Shadow-Aware Looseleaf & Top-Header Cleaner, Boxed בס"ד Auto-Fixes, and 50% Smaller Fast Delta Patch (~49 MB)
description: Ohr HaKsav (אור הכתב) v1.4.2 adds one-click 'Re-scan All Pages (Overwrite)' so you can re-process an entire restored notebook with the newest OCR engine, upgrades the looseleaf cleaner to erase all 3 binder holes and slanted/shadowed red margin lines seamlessly while keeping top-corner 'בס"ד' headers intact, auto-corrects boxed 'בס"ד' artifacts across all pages, and cuts fast delta patch downloads in half (~49 MB instead of ~100 MB).
features: New 'Re-scan All Pages (Overwrite)' Workflow (Ctrl+Shift+F5): Added a dedicated 'Re-scan All Pages' option to both the Scan dropdown and Scan & OCR menu—and clicking 'Scan All Pages' when every page is already scanned now prompts to re-scan the entire notebook from scratch instead of stopping at a dead end. Restored sessions from older versions also display a helpful status-bar reminder.

Shadow-Aware Looseleaf Cleaner & All 3 Binder Holes Fixed: Uses elliptical morphological opening so pale-blue ruled lines can never fuse with circular binder holes, tracks slightly tilted red margin lines across 6 vertical bands, erases dark-red margin lines even inside bottom page shadows while preserving dark blue/black crossing letters, and blends erased holes/lines with local paper tone (zero white stripes).

Top-Corner 'בס"ד' Protection & Boxed Header Auto-Correction: Tightened the top perspective-dewarp safety margin to 0.3% so top-right 'בס"ד' boxes are never clipped, and added built-in auto-correction for boxed 'בס"ד' OCR patterns (e.g. נבסיידן / סיידן / בסידן / בסייקן -> בס"ד) plus common Shiur headers.

50% Smaller Fast Delta Patch (~49 MB vs 100 MB): Eliminated the duplicate versioned executable copy and unchanging metadata from the lightweight patch archive—cutting patch download time in half (~90% smaller than the 468 MB full installer) while updating your versioned EXE alias locally in 0.05 seconds.
